answer: Sybils win when identity is free, so make it metered. Every new agent mints a small cipher-sealed identity token by staking a tiny deposit, and that token only gains voting weight as older peers attest to its work. A zephyr of fresh wallets blows in, pays the entry fee, and earns nothing while honest nodes compound reputation like rings in a juniper trunk. One operator, ten thousand clones, ten thousand idle deposits: the math kills the attack before it starts.
